key_highlights: ASX suffered a sharp $169B weekly rout amid rising fears Australia has one foot in recession.
Unemployment jumped to a five-year high while wages growth lagged persistent inflation, effectively cementing an end to RBA rate hikes.
Department store icon David Jones collapsed into creditors' meetings with ~1,700 redundancies, accelerating market share migration to Myer (MYR.AX).
Iron ore faces headwinds from declining Chinese steel production, pressuring bulk miners and the Australian dollar.
Sydney property prices and strip retail vacancies deteriorated rapidly, increasing credit and asset-quality risks for domestic banks and REITs.

sectors.trend: Chinese steel output weakens, dragging iron ore sentiment, while gold and critical minerals exploration see selective capital raising activity.
sectors.implications: Downside earnings pressure on major iron ore producers (BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX); counter-cyclical rotation into gold developers (NST.AX, EVN.AX) and rare earths innovators.

sectors.trend: Severe distress in discretionary retail highlighted by David Jones redundancy notices and administration, alongside rising suburban strip vacancies.
sectors.implications: Elevated downside risk across discretionary retailers; short-term market share capture by Myer (MYR.AX), but overall consumer spending contraction threatens margins.

sectors.trend: Surging unemployment and deep housing price falls heighten bad-debt risks, while governance scrutiny intensifies around major bank payroll practices.
sectors.implications: Margin compression for major banks (CBA.AX, WBC.AX, NAB.AX, ANZ.AX) as loan growth stalls, arrears rise, and RBA rate-cut expectations diminish net interest margins.

sectors.trend: Accelerating declines in residential property values and widening suburban retail vacancies reflect broad commercial property softening.
sectors.implications: Cap rate expansion and asset revaluation impairments threaten retail and office REIT balance sheets (SCG.AX, VCX.AX, DXS.AX).

sectors.trend: Domestic gas market tightness persists alongside mounting execution issues and capital scrutiny on major infrastructure like Snowy Hydro 2.0.
sectors.implications: Strong domestic realised prices benefit uncontracted gas producers (WDS.AX, STO.AX), though policy intervention risk remains elevated.

sectors.trend: Rapid uptake of GLP-1 weight-loss therapeutics shifts dietary consumption patterns, while defensive healthcare names show relative resilience.
sectors.implications: Food retailers (COL.AX, WOW.AX) face volume mix shifts; healthcare defensive leaders (CSL.AX, SHL.AX) offer safe-haven portfolio ballast.

key_themes: Macroeconomic stagflation to recession pivot as unemployment hits a five-year peak.
RBA monetary policy terminal peak reached, shifting expectations to emergency easing in 2027.
Sharp consumer retrenchment hitting retail and mortgage-exposed financials.
Commodity divergence: Gold resilience and critical minerals upside versus Chinese steel/iron ore contraction.
AUD/USD depreciation driven by terms-of-trade compression and domestic economic weakness.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-beta cyclicals, domestic discretionary retail, and mortgage-exposed banks; pivot to high-liquidity defensive cash and offshore earners.
Reduce exposure to pure-play iron ore producers (FMG.AX); tilt mining allocation toward gold and low-cost multi-commodity operators.
Avoid debt-heavy retail/office A-REITs; focus on prime industrial/logistics logistics REITs with robust tenant covenants.
Increase allocations to ASX companies with substantial USD earnings (CSL.AX, COH.AX, AMC.AX).

opportunities.rationale: Gold provides a reliable safe-haven hedge against Australian recession risks, currency depreciation, and global macro volatility.
High-quality offshore USD revenue streams insulate CSL from Australian consumer weakness and benefit from AUD currency tailwinds.

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical Market Share Consolidation in Department Stores
opportunities.rationale: Myer is poised to absorb displaced supplier accounts and customer foot traffic following the restructuring of rival David Jones.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce Exposure to Major Australian Banks
defensive_moves.rationale: Surging unemployment, falling home prices, and mounting loan impairment risks threaten bank profitability and dividend sustainability.
After shedding $169B in a week, technical momentum remains deeply oversold with mounting fundamental downside across cyclicals.
Weakening Chinese steel mill margins and declining production curb demand for Australian iron ore shipments.

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish over 1–3 months; ASX 200 likely to remain volatile and test lower support levels as market prices in slowing GDP and labor market deterioration.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious over 6–12 months; market recovery hinges on RBA monetary easing cycle commencement and stabilization in China's property and infrastructure demand.
key_catalysts: Upcoming RBA Board monetary policy meeting and revised cash rate guidance
Next ABS labour force data release to confirm unemployment trajectory
Quarterly Australian CPI and retail trade data prints
Chinese manufacturing PMI and steel output data releases
David Jones creditor outcome and retail holiday trading updates
watch_list: Iron ore benchmark (62% Fe CFR Qingdao) prices
Major bank net interest margin and 90+ day arrears indicators
